subject: Grant of insignia to the Swamigalu of Sri Sankaracharya Virupaksha Samsthanam, Hampi, Bellary District
what_is_said: The maṭh's agent petitions the Maharaja for leave for the Svāmī to tour Mysore with paraphernalia "said to have been allowed to him by the Government of Madras". Asked for documents, the Svāmī says they "were left behind in the Nizam's Dominions" and that "his Mutt is a branch of Sri Sringeri Mutt". The Muzrai Commissioner (17 Dec 1935) refuses the royal honours for want of information on "the status of the Mutt, the circle of its disciples and the standing of the present Head", and allows only ordinary insignia (mena, elephants, camels, horses, bulls, carts, cows, buggies, servants, silver canes, mantaps). Dewan's note 7 Feb 1936.
quote: stated that his Mutt is a branch of Sri Sringeri Mutt and that he may be allowed the facilities and conveniences given to Sri Sringeri Mutt

subject: Presentation of an Elephant to Sri Kanchi Komakoti matt at Kumbakonam. (Sri Sankaracharya swamigal matt)
what_is_said: The Mysore State presents an elephant to the maṭh, by then catalogued as the Kāñcī Kāmakoṭi maṭh at Kumbakoṇam.
quote: (description) "Presentation of an Elephant to Sri Kanchi Komakoti matt at Kumbakonam. (Sri Sankaracharya swamigal matt)"

subject: Presentation of an elephant to His Highness the Jagadguru Sri Sankaracharya swami mutt of Conjeevaram

subject: Monthly grant of Rs.5/- … in the temple of Sri Sankaracharya belonging to Sri Avani Mutt at Kolar
what_is_said: The Avani maṭh (Rice: "a guru of the Smarta sect resides here") has a temple of Śaṅkarācārya, supported by a State grant of Rs 5 a month.
quote: (description) "Monthly grant of Rs.5/- to meet the expenses of Paditara and Deeparadhane in the temple of Sri Sankaracharya belonging to Sri Avani Mutt at kolar"
